grades.main_gap: No proof that the minimal-family evolution terminates (new primes could appear infinitely often); the attempt cuts off mid-sentence. The global from-n=1 periodicity (no skipped multiples in the initial segment) is also unproved.
grades.notes: Correct reformulation via prime supports, minimal families, and blockers; proves the nontrivial lemma that an intersecting clutter has intersecting blocker iff every minimal transversal contains an edge (stable = self-dual); shows instability forces a change via 'pure multiples'; fully handles the singleton case; verifies a1=35. But finiteness of changes and exact global periodicity—two central parts—remain open.
